minutes.headline: Zoning board granted a 10-foot front setback special permit for a farmer's porch at 28 Charlton Street.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals held a remote meeting and heard one case: Carl and Susan Rose's request for relief from the front yard setback to build an 8 by 45 foot farmer's porch. The Green Leaf Botanicals variance hearing was continued to June 9 at the applicant's request. The porch permit was granted and the meeting adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals voted 4-0 to grant a 10-foot front setback special permit for a farmer's porch at 28 Charlton Street.
The permit carries standard conditions: compliance with applicable laws, periodic review, and no effect until recorded at the registry of deeds.
The Green Leaf Botanicals variance hearing at 88 Massachusetts Avenue was continued to June 9 at 7 p.m. at the applicant's request, citing illness; the case was not heard.
The board set its next meeting for June 9 at 7 p.m.

why_it_matters: The porch ruling is a small, single-property exception to the front yard setback rule; it affects one lot and no town budget line.
The Green Leaf Botanicals variance has not been heard yet, so any decision on that property at 88 Massachusetts Avenue waits until the June 9 hearing.
